# About {.unnumbered}

A worked book for empirical asset pricing using Python Polars and local WRDS
Parquet files. The chapters build from size portfolios to factor adjustment,
double sorts, and Fama–MacBeth regression, inspired by Bali, Engle, and Murray's *Empirical Asset Pricing: The Cross Section
of Stock Returns*. [AnomalyLab](https://github.com/FinPhD/AnomalyLab) is an
independent numerical reference, not a reader dependency.

The comparisons use the same input panels in each implementation. It does
not claim to reproduce a published table or redistribute WRDS data.
